body:
Wow, a PR so fast? 💯

About the way you defined it, I'm just wondering: wouldn't this be the first time we wrap a template inside a subobject of a widget?

I couldn't find any other case of this, correct me if I'm wrong, but for consistency, it might be better to go with `templates.poweredBy`, and then `cssClasses.poweredBy{Root,Link}` or `cssClasses.poweredBy.{root,link}`, no?
